newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Telecel rises strongly after good H1 net.
newsitem.headline: Telecel rises strongly after good H1 net.

text.p: Shares in Telecel-Comunicacoes Pessoais rose by more than one percent and were in tune with the overall bullish mood of the Lisbon bourse after the Portuguese mobile phone operator posted strong first half results.
"Telecel's results came out in line with market expectations. They were good," a dealer said.

Another said: "The stock is being supported by the firm trend on the domestic market, in line with the strong rises in the main European markets, after the positive report from U.S. Fed chairman Alan Greenspan."
Telecel's first half net profit rose 127 percent to 5.851 billion escudos.
Telecel shares stood at 14,380 escudos, up 232, in volume of 113,880 at 1030 GMT.
